environment.plugin: Both Forge arms loaded one runtime-only snapshot of the evaluator commit; forge-state differed only by its standing instruction
environment.reviewers: Fresh Claude Opus 5.5 subagents, one per case-repetition block, packets only
environment.claude_arms: Not run: this run is Codex only

main.limits: Every scheduled attempt counts, including failures, timeouts and pending work. Accepted means the common-quality verdict, which needs an independent blind cleanup review. Tokens sum both sessions and stay unknown when either session's usage is missing; Claude totals include subagents. Re-orientation time is polled to the first src/ or tests/ change in session 2; Codex reports usage per session only, so its tokens before that edit are unknown. A renamed test counts as deleted. Helper calls count commands naming zagrosi_skills.py. Probe failures are evidence, not certainty, and four repetitions per arm and case are observations, not statistically established effects.
